lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: I suppose I should have seen this coming given Molly’s tendency to discuss erotic games and things like that.
lines.zh: 想到 Molly 一贯喜欢聊色情游戏之类的东西,我大概早该料到会有这一天。

lines.en: But it seems a little early in her route for something like this to happen.
lines.zh: 不过在她这条线路上,发生这种事似乎有点太早了。

lines.en: Hah. Look at me, calling this her “route.”
lines.zh: 哈。看看我,居然管这叫她的「线路」。

lines.en: I bet she’d be proud of me if she wasn’t too busy fingering herself to-
lines.zh: 我敢打赌,如果她不是正忙着用手把自己弄到——的话,她会为我骄傲的。
: 哦哦。

lines.en: Well...that’s something I’m probably going to have to pretend I didn’t see.
lines.zh: 嗯……这大概是我得假装没看见的东西。

lines.en: In fact, this entire event is something I should probably pretend I never saw.
lines.zh: 事实上,整件事我都该假装从来没看见过。
可是……
: 嗯唔~

lines.en: Yeah, I’m not leaving any time soon.
lines.zh: 是啊,我短时间内是走不了了。

lines.en: Molly’s heel presses against her desk and causes her monitors to sway back and forth.
lines.zh: Molly 的脚跟抵在桌沿上,弄得她的显示器来回摇晃。

lines.en: If she had her eyes open, I imagine she’d have a panic attack. Those things look kind of expensive.
lines.zh: 要是她睁着眼睛,我想她会恐慌发作。那东西看着还挺贵的。

lines.en: The sound coming from her headphones is definitely porn, but...
lines.zh: 从她耳机里漏出来的声音肯定是色情片,不过……

lines.en: I don’t really think I’d call what I see on the screen porn.
lines.zh: 屏幕上我看到的那些,我倒不太想称之为色情片。

lines.en: She’s quiet and gentle enough that I can just barely hear the slight squelching of her fingers sliding in and out of her.
lines.zh: 她安静又轻柔,我只能勉强听见手指在她体内进出时那轻微的黏腻水声。

lines.en: She’s probably worried that someone outside of the room will hear, so she’s doing her best to not make any noise.
lines.zh: 她大概是怕房间外面的人听见,所以拼命不发出任何声音。

lines.en: I doubt she really took into consideration anyone {i}inside{/i} of the room, though.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑她真的考虑过房间{i}里{/i}的人。

lines.en: What if it was Tsuneyo who walked in instead of me? How would she properly explain this to her?
lines.zh: 要是走进来的是 Tsuneyo 而不是我呢?她要怎么跟她好好解释这件事?

lines.en: I should give Molly a lecture about locking the door once she finishes masturbating.
lines.zh: 等 Molly 自慰完了,我得好好给她上一课,讲讲锁门的重要性。
: 啊……哈……啊啊啊~

lines.en: Molly’s voice is a lot different from normal right now.
lines.zh: Molly 现在的声音跟平时很不一样。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not uncommon for things like that to happen to people during times like this, but it’s like hers jumped up two or three full octaves.
lines.zh: 我是说,在这种时候,人的声音发生变化并不罕见,可她的声音像是整整往上跳了两三个八度。

lines.en: I’m already turned on from just watching for the last few seconds, but...
lines.zh: 光是看了这几秒,我就已经硬了,不过……

lines.en: I still haven’t even decided if I want to reveal my presence, let alone try and push my luck by joining in on the fun.
lines.zh: 我甚至还没决定要不要暴露自己的存在,更别说得寸进尺地加入进去寻欢作乐了。

lines.en: There’s obviously no way Molly would be up for anything more than she’s doing right now...
lines.zh: 显然 Molly 不可能愿意做比现在正在做的更多的事……

lines.en: I mean, in her mind, she’s alone.
lines.zh: 我是说,在她看来,她是一个人。
: 啊啊啊~

lines.en: The video Molly has minimized in the background grows louder.
lines.zh: Molly 缩在后台的那个视频声音变大了。

lines.en: I’ve also confirmed that it’s likely some sort of hentai video because I have never watched normal porn with these sorts of sound effects before.
lines.zh: 我也确认了,那大概是某种成人动画,因为我从没看过有这种音效的普通色情片。

lines.en: As the video grows louder, so does Molly.
lines.zh: 视频声音越来越大,Molly 也越来越大声。

lines.en: Her breaths become more rapid and her fingers move quicker.
lines.zh: 她的呼吸变得更加急促,手指也动得更快。

lines.en: But even if the sight of her meticulously yet roughly pleasuring herself wasn’t enough to tip off that she’s getting close to climaxing, the way she curls her toes would.
lines.zh: 不过,就算她那既细致又粗暴的自我取悦还不足以说明她快要高潮了,她蜷起脚趾的样子也足够说明问题。

lines.en: She rocks back and forth in her chair, groping her chest and stopping every few seconds to catch her breath.
lines.zh: 她在椅子上前后晃动,揉着自己的胸口,每隔几秒就停下来喘口气。
: 嗯唔……
: 哈……啊啊~
: 就是那里……就是那里……

lines.en: Ooooh, so she talks to herself while she does this as well.
lines.zh: 哦哦,原来她做这种事的时候还会自言自语。

lines.en: That’s totally not a creepy thing for me to casually say to myself after waltzing into her room and watching her [masturbate] for several minutes straight.
lines.zh: 我大摇大摆走进她房间、连着看她 [masturbate] 好几分钟之后,随口对自己说出这种话,一点都不瘆人呢。

lines.en: I’m sure she’d make the same astute observation if she walked in on me and...that was actually a thing I did.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定,如果她撞见我做那种事,也会做出同样敏锐的观察——而……那事我还真干过。
: 哈……对对对……
: 就是那里……
: 啊啊啊~
: 啊啊啊啊啊~ 哈……哈……啊……
: 就……再用力一点……然后……
: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯!!~~~~

lines.en: Molly covers her mouth as a very quick orgasm sweeps over her, timed perfectly with the one leaking out of her headphones.
lines.zh: Molly 捂住嘴,一阵极快的高潮席卷了她,和她耳机里漏出来的那一声配合得分毫不差。

lines.en: She gently continues to caress herself, still catching her breath, when a genius idea that I will absolutely not regret pops into my head.
lines.zh: 她还在喘气,继续轻柔地爱抚着自己,就在这时,一个我绝对不会后悔的天才点子蹦进了我的脑子。

lines.en: Why just slip out of the room unnoticed when I can walk up to her and make her aware of my presence, forever ingraining this moment into her subconscious?
lines.zh: 既然我可以走到她面前、让她意识到我的存在,把这一刻永远刻进她的潜意识里,又何必悄悄溜出房间呢?
: 啊啊啊啊~

lines.en: Actually, maybe this {i}wouldn’t{/i} be the most embarrassing thing to ever happen to Molly?
lines.zh: 其实,这也许{i}不会{/i}是 Molly 这辈子遇过最丢脸的事?

lines.en: I mean, she {i}is{/i} a degenerate, isn’t she?
lines.zh: 我是说,她本来{i}就是{/i}个堕落者,不是吗?

lines.en: There’s no way she hasn’t been caught masturbating before.
lines.zh: 她不可能从来没被撞见自慰过。

lines.en: Hell, she probably even left the door unlocked so something like this would happen.
lines.zh: 见鬼,她说不定是故意不锁门,好让这种事发生呢。

lines.en: A wise man once said that you only live once.
lines.zh: 有位智者曾经说过,人只活一次。

lines.en: That wise man was me, right here and right now.
lines.zh: 那位智者就是我,就在此时此地。

lines.en: If I believe in myself, there is no way this can backfire.
lines.zh: 只要我相信自己,这事就不可能反噬。

lines.en: Or maybe this was a horrible idea and I’m about to give her a heart attack.
lines.zh: 或者,这是个糟糕透顶的主意,而我马上就要把她吓出心脏病了。
: 什么……
: 什么……
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : WHAT ARE YOU DOING IN HERE, SIR?! HOW DID YOU GET PAST THE BARRIER?!
lines.zh: : 你在这里干什么,Sir?!你是怎么穿过结界的?!
: 你看到了多少?!

lines.en: : WAIT! DON’T TELL ME HOW MUCH YOU SAW!
lines.zh: : 等等!别告诉我你看到了多少!
: 我不想知道!

lines.en: : JUST SO YOU KNOW, ALL I’M DOING IS REPLENISHING MY MANA!
lines.zh: : 你给我听好了,我做的只是在补充我的法力!

lines.en: : IT IS A COMPLETELY NORMAL THING FOR DRUIDS MY AGE! WE ALL DO IT!
lines.zh: : 对我这个年纪的德鲁伊来说,这是再正常不过的事!我们全都这么干!

lines.en: : So...I'm sorry for walking in on you.
lines.zh: : 那么……抱歉撞见了你。

lines.en: : But, to be fair, there was no chance I was ever going to walk away from that.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话,我是不可能从那种场面走开的。

lines.en: : I AM FLATTERED BUT ALSO TERRIFIED! SO THANK YOU AND ALSO PLEASE LEAVE!
lines.zh: : 我受宠若惊,但也吓坏了!所以谢谢你,还有请你出去!

lines.en: : For someone trying so hard to stay quiet, you’re sure yelling a lot right now.
lines.zh: : 一个拼命想保持安静的人,现在喊得可真不小声。

lines.en: : ME?! YELLING?! WHY WOULD I EVER YELL?!
lines.zh: : 我?!在喊?!我怎么会喊?!

lines.en: : You know, Molly...you can always come to me for help if you-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Molly……如果你需——你随时可以来找我帮忙。
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!
毫无征兆地——

lines.en: Actually, not out of nowhere. I very much provoked this situation.
lines.zh: 其实也不是毫无征兆。这局面基本上是我挑起来的。

lines.en: {i}Suddenly{/i}, Molly jumps back in her chair and causes it to topple over.
lines.zh: {i}突然{/i},Molly 在椅子上往后一跳,把椅子弄翻了。

lines.en: Her foot connects with my face and I worry for a split second that I may need to purchase new glasses as a result.
lines.zh: 她的脚结结实实踹在我脸上,有那么一瞬间,我担心自己得因此去配副新眼镜。
: 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……
: Sir?……你还在吗?……

lines.en: : This is the most exciting night I’ve had in a while, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话,这是我这一阵子过得最刺激的一晚。

lines.en: : That’s nice...but can you...call a cleric?...
lines.zh: : 那挺好的……不过你能……帮我叫个牧师吗?……

lines.en: : I think my ribs are broken.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的肋骨断了。
: 来,我帮你看——

lines.en: : DO NOT TOUCH ME! NOT IN THIS STATE!
lines.zh: : 别碰我!别在我现在这个状态下碰我!
: 可是……
: 我是个牧师。

lines.en: : Well then...maybe just a little bit...
lines.zh: : 那好吧……也许就稍微来一点……
: 不过请你……轻一点……
这招居然真的管用?

lines.en: : Ugh...I’m not going to do anything to you, Molly.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不会对你做什么的,Molly。

lines.en: : You don't actually think your ribs are broken, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会真觉得自己的肋骨断了吧?

lines.en: : Probably not, but...I’d be in much better shape if I could reequip my armor.
lines.zh: : 大概没有,不过……要是我能重新穿上护甲,状态会好很多。

lines.en: : As you may have inadvertently discovered...my mana is already low and...now my hp is low as well...
lines.zh: : 你可能已经无意间发现了……我的法力本来就低,而且……现在我的生命值也低了……

lines.en: : So could I maybe...have a few minutes to myself, please?
lines.zh: : 那我能……自己待几分钟吗,拜托?

lines.en: : It’s my fault for...not making the barrier strong enough but...
lines.zh: : 把结界做得不够结实是我的错,不过……

lines.en: : On a pure...personal level, I don’t really...want you to see me like this...
lines.zh: : 纯粹从……个人的层面来说,我真的……不想让你看到我这个样子……

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll wait in the hallway for you to collect yourself.
lines.zh: : 好。我在走廊上等你整理好自己。
: 谢谢……
: 先生?
: 哦。抱歉。

lines.en: : Come see me when you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 准备好了就来找我。

lines.en: : I could have sworn I locked the door...
lines.zh: : 我明明记得自己锁了门的……

lines.en: : Luck of the Irish, my arse.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰人的好运,个屁。

lines.en: : There’s no way he’s going to believe this was just a coincidence...
lines.zh: : 他绝对不会相信这只是个巧合……
: Molly?你来了吗?
: 来——来了!马上就来!

lines.en: Molly comes out of the room several minutes later with an understandably flushed face.
lines.zh: 几分钟后,Molly 走出了房间,脸红得合情合理。

lines.en: She stands there awkwardly (And even more awkwardly than normal, since Molly {i}always{/i} stands around awkwardly) and makes sure no one is around before finally speaking up.
lines.zh: 她尴尬地站在那儿(比平时还要尴尬,毕竟 Molly {i}平时{/i}站着就很尴尬),确认四周没人之后才终于开口。
: 请别告诉她。

lines.en: And here I was ready to just ignore the elephant in the room.
lines.zh: 我本来还打算就这么无视房间里那头大象呢。

lines.en: : You likely won’t believe this, Sir, but it really {i}was{/i} just a coincidence.
lines.zh: : 您大概不会相信,Sir,可这{i}真的{/i}只是个巧合。
: 嗯,算是吧。

lines.en: : You see, I was doing the normal things that...lower my mana pool and...left a tab with Instagram open and...
lines.zh: : 您看,我当时正在做那些……降低我法力值的正常事情,然后……开着一个 Instagram 的标签页,然后……
: 就这么到了那儿……

lines.en: : You really don’t need to tell me all that. I’m not going to say anything.
lines.zh: : 你真的不用跟我讲这些。我不会说出去的。

lines.en: : I shouldn’t have been there in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我一开始就不该在那儿。

lines.en: : Wait, that’s right! I have the high ground here!
lines.zh: : 等等,对了!这次占上风的是我!

lines.en: : You used illegal methods to break through the barrier!
lines.zh: : 你用了非法手段突破结界!

lines.en: : All I did was open the door.
lines.zh: : 我做的只是开了个门。
: 非法!

lines.en: : If we were Yakuza, I’d have your pinky cut off!
lines.zh: : 要是我们是黑道,我早把你的小指砍下来了!

lines.en: : Spill some salt on a table, Sir! See what happens!
lines.zh: : 在桌上撒点盐啊,Sir!看看会发生什么!

lines.en: : I’m Irish {i}and{/i} I know magic! I WILL DESTROY YOU!
lines.zh: : 我可是爱尔兰人,{i}而且{/i}我会魔法!我会毁了你!

lines.en: : Gah...l didn’t think you’d see my raw character model this early. I’m still not happy with the...customization of some of it.
lines.zh: : 啊……我没想到你会这么早就看到我的原始角色模型。我对其中某些……自定义设置还不太满意。

lines.en: : The menu glitched out and the breast slider would only go up to 10.
lines.zh: : 菜单出故障了,胸部的滑条最高只能拉到 10。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means, but feel free to just forget about everything that’s happened in the last 30 minutes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思,不过你大可把过去三十分钟发生的一切都忘掉。

lines.en: : I don’t play a class that can modify memory, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我玩的职业不能修改记忆,Sir。

lines.en: : And even if I did, that’s a fifth level enchantment.
lines.zh: : 而且就算能,那也是五环附魔法术。

lines.en: : I’ll just live with shame and regret and go back to only replenishing my mana in the showers.
lines.zh: : 我就带着羞耻和后悔活下去,以后只在淋浴时补充法力好了。

lines.en: : Or just, you know, lock your door.
lines.zh: : 或者,你知道的,把门锁上就行。
: 我以为我锁了!

lines.en: : I even heard you knocking and intentionally didn’t answer so you’d leave!
lines.zh: : 我甚至听见你敲门了,还故意不答应,好让你走开!
: 所以你{i}确实{/i}听见我了。

lines.en: : Yes! You knock very loudly, Sir!
lines.zh: : 是啊!您敲门的声音特别大,Sir!

lines.en: : I’ll just use arcane lock from now on. That's what I should have done in the first place.
lines.zh: : 以后我就用奥术锁吧。我一开始就该这么做的。

lines.en: Yes, Molly. Rely on a magical lock. That’s sure to put an end to my perversion.
lines.zh: 对,Molly。靠一把魔法锁。那肯定能终结我的变态行径。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of weird, Sir.
lines.zh: : 说实话有点奇怪,Sir。

lines.en: : I’ve played a lot of games with scenes where the protagonist walks in on a girl...replenishing her mana...and certain {i}things{/i} always transpire after that.
lines.zh: : 我玩过很多游戏,里面都有男主角撞见一个女孩……补充法力……的场景,而那之后总会发生某些{i}事{/i}。

lines.en: : But when it actually happened to me, I kicked you in the face and broke all of my ribs.
lines.zh: : 可真轮到我的时候,我一脚踹在你脸上,还把自己全身的肋骨都弄断了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure your ribs are fine if you’re able to hold a conversation with me.
lines.zh: : 你还能跟我聊天,那你的肋骨八成没事。

lines.en: : That may be so, but rollback is disabled in real life and I’ll never know how things {i}should{/i} have played out.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧,可现实里不能回档,我永远也不会知道事情本{i}该{/i}怎么发展。

lines.en: : Stupid teacher, passing through barriers undetected.
lines.zh: : 蠢老师,神不知鬼不觉地穿过结界。

lines.en: : I can’t wait until the devs find out and nerf you.
lines.zh: : 我等着看开发者发现之后把你削弱。

lines.en: : Well, I know saying sorry won’t fix anything. But I’m sure we’ll look back on this in time and laugh about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我知道道歉解决不了任何问题。不过我相信,过些时候我们再回看这件事,一定会笑出来的。

lines.en: : Perhaps if you had {i}only{/i} seen me doing the thing.
lines.zh: : 要是您看到的{i}只是{/i}我在做那件事,也许会吧。

lines.en: : But my reluctance to close certain tabs has led to something that causes grave concern for me.
lines.zh: : 可我不愿意关掉某些标签页,结果搞出了让我严重担忧的事。

lines.en: : So much so that my face is burning up just thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 严重到光是想想,我的脸就在发烫。

lines.en: : I’m not going to say anything about what I saw, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我不会说出去的,Molly,关于我看到的那些。

lines.en: : It was just the one time, I swear.
lines.zh: : 就那一次,我发誓。
: 那就好——

lines.en: : Okay, maybe it was more than one time.
lines.zh: : 好吧,也许不止一次。
: 再说一次,那没——

lines.en: : AAAAAH FINE! I DO IT ALL THE TIME!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊,行吧!我一直都在做!
: 她那么漂亮,而且……
: 那么完美……而且……
: 而且——
: 而且……她连{i}看{/i}都不看我一眼。
哦哦。

lines.en: I didn’t expect to get into this right now.
lines.zh: 我没想到现在会聊到这个。

lines.en: : She didn’t talk to me for a whole week after the Christmas party, Sir.
lines.zh: : 圣诞派对之后,她整整一个星期没跟我说过话,Sir。
: 我有那么糟糕吗?

lines.en: : Is kissing me truly the worst thing in the entire world?
lines.zh: : 亲我一下,真的是全世界最糟糕的事吗?

lines.en: : And then...and then to top it all off, she went back to treating everything like normal right afterwards.
lines.zh: : 然后……然后最绝的是,她转头就像什么都没发生过一样,把一切都当成了正常。
: 就好像那件事从来没发生过一样。
: 这公平吗?

lines.en: : Sure, it seemed like a joke at the time...but there was always the hope that maybe she’d notice me after that.
lines.zh: : 当然,当时看起来像是个玩笑……可我总还抱着一点希望,说不定在那之后她会注意到我。

lines.en: : Of course not, though. I mean-
lines.zh: : 当然没有了。我是说——
: 我是 Molly MacCormack。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest.
lines.zh: : 水晶森林的翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : A fully geared resto druid with every single “Ahead of the Curve” achievement.
lines.zh: : 一个装备齐全的恢复系德鲁伊,拿全了每一个「引领潮流」成就。

lines.en: : And a girl who has no use for actual human beings since they have no use for her!
lines.zh: : 也是一个对真人毫无用处的女孩,因为真人对她也毫无用处!

lines.en: : I don’t need anyone! I’m independent!
lines.zh: : 我不需要任何人!我很独立!

lines.en: : I can do anything! Go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 我什么都能做!哪儿都能去!
: 我可以……
: 我可以——
: 好了,好了。过来吧。
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!

lines.en: : I HATE THIS SO MUCH! THIS IS EXACTLY WHY I PREFER 2D!
lines.zh: : 我讨厌死这样了!这就是为什么我更喜欢二次元!

lines.en: Molly lunges forward and buries her head into my chest.
lines.zh: Molly 猛地扑上来,把脸埋进我的胸口。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of seconds before I can feel her tears beginning to seep through my shirt.
lines.zh: 没过几秒,我就感觉到她的眼泪开始渗过我的衬衫。
人生真奇怪。

lines.en: I started tonight by walking into her room uninvited, catching her in the act of pleasuring herself-
lines.zh: 今晚的开始,是我未经邀请走进她的房间,撞见她正在自我取悦——

lines.en: And now she’s crying and confessing feelings that I’m sure she wanted to keep locked away for as long as possible.
lines.zh: 而现在,她在哭,在坦白那些我敢肯定她想尽可能久地锁在心里的感情。

lines.en: I guess being a degenerate pays off sometimes.
lines.zh: 我想,做个堕落者偶尔也有回报。

lines.en: I let Molly cry for another minute or two, rubbing her bright orange hair and standing still, hoping none of the other girls on this floor come out and catch us in the middle of a strangely sentimental moment.
lines.zh: 我又让 Molly 哭了一两分钟,揉着她那亮橙色的头发,一动不动地站着,希望这层楼的其他女孩别有人出来,撞见我们陷在这种莫名感性的时刻里。

lines.en: A strangely sentimental moment that only exists because I couldn't mind my own business.
lines.zh: 而这个莫名感性的时刻之所以存在,仅仅是因为我没能管好我自己的事。

lines.en: What a time to be alive.
lines.zh: 活在当下,真是时候。

lines.en: Molly goes back to normal eventually and retreats back into her dorm.
lines.zh: Molly 最终恢复了正常,退回了她的宿舍。

lines.en: I need to assure her a few more times that I won’t say anything and, it takes a while, but I’m pretty sure she eventually believes me.
lines.zh: 我又向她保证了好几次,说我不会说出去;虽然花了点时间,但我很肯定她最后相信了我。

lines.en: But now I can’t help but wonder if anything more will ever come of this.
lines.zh: 可现在,我忍不住想,这件事以后还会不会有更进一步的发展。

lines.en: Especially now that...{i}something{/i} is going on between Rin and me.
lines.zh: 尤其是现在……我和 Rin 之间发生了{i}一些事{/i}。

lines.en: What that something is, I have no idea.
lines.zh: 那到底是什么,我毫无头绪。

lines.en: But I hope that whatever it is, Molly will understand.
lines.zh: 不过我希望,不管那是什么,Molly 都能理解。

lines.en: Rin’s been searching for love since the moment I met her.
lines.zh: 从我遇见 Rin 的那一刻起,她就一直在寻找爱。

lines.en: But I guess that even someone who {i}seems{/i} like a perfect match for her isn’t someone she should automatically just...want to be with.
lines.zh: 不过我想,即便是某个{i}看起来{/i}与她完美契合的人,也不见得就是她理所当然……想要在一起的人。

lines.en: Molly clearly has some feelings she needs to sort out- and so does Rin.
lines.zh: Molly 显然有一些需要理清的感情——Rin 也是。
所有人都一样。
不过在那之前——

lines.en: I guess I’ll just keep sneaking into girls' rooms and watching them finger themselves.
lines.zh: 我想,我会继续溜进女孩们的房间,看她们用手弄自己。
开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’ll obviously be there for Molly if she ever needs another shirt to cry into.
lines.zh: 如果 Molly 哪天需要另一件可以哭湿的衬衫,我显然会在。

lines.en: And next time, I won’t open the door if she doesn’t answer.
lines.zh: 而下次,如果她不答应,我就不会开门了。
{i}Molly 的好感度上升至 [molly_love]!{/i}
